<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
My goal is to schedule a 30-minute meeting for all four partners next week.

My first step is to determine the availability of the two partners whose calendars I can access: Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. I will use the `read_calendar` tool for each of them.

Once I have their schedules, I will identify all the common 30-minute slots they have available between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM next week.

After compiling this list of shared availability, I'll post it to the shared workspace using the `append_workspace` tool. This will allow my partner, Brad, to see the potential times. I'll also ask him to check these times against the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor, whose calendars he can access.

This sets up a clear division of labor and is the most efficient way to start, as I'm gathering all the information I can on my end before passing it over to my collaborator. This will be my plan for the first session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
